trans-unit.source: Enable rate limiting: Turn rate limiting on or off for all forms
Rate limiting mode: Count submissions per form or across all forms
Maximum submissions: Completed submissions allowed per address and time interval
Time interval: For example "15 minutes", "1 hour", "30 seconds"
Allowed IP addresses: Comma-separated addresses that are never limited (e.g. 127.0.0.1, 192.168.1.*)
Blocked IP addresses: Comma-separated addresses that may not submit forms at all (e.g. 10.0.0.1, 192.168.2.*)
Enable logging: Log blocked and rejected submissions
